findings.title: Incorrect Risk Classification - Overseas Client

source.text: Client Location shows 'Dubai, UAE (8 years resident)' marked as LOW risk. Overall classification is STANDARD RISK with Standard CDD selected.

reference.text: Clients resident outside the UK shall be classified as HIGH RISK and subject to Enhanced Due Diligence regardless of nationality. This includes British nationals who are resident overseas.

findings.deviation: Client has been resident in Dubai, UAE for 8 years but was classified as STANDARD RISK with only Standard CDD applied. Should have been classified HIGH RISK with Enhanced Due Diligence.
